name: Cyanotype
sub: A sun print. Sensitizer is brushed on in ragged strokes that pool where the brush lands and run dry where it lifts; a fern, grass or a die sits on top and the sun does the rest. Where light reached, Prussian blue; under the object, paper. Lifted parts throw soft, offset shadows away from the sheet light — pressed parts stay sharp.

entry.call: fx.run(o, W, H, dpr, { S, clips })

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.clips: Float32Array alpha per name (obj), from FXSET.clips('fx-11-cyanotype', W, H, dpr, o) on a thread with fonts
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Subject
params.note: what lies on the sheet: a procedural fern frond, grass with seed heads, or a die mark

params.label: Die
params.note: an invented mark cut from card

params.label: Brush strokes
params.note: strokes laid top to bottom, alternating direction

params.label: Brush-edge raggedness
params.note: how far bristles and drag push each stroke edge in and out

params.label: Coating unevenness
params.note: streaks and drag in the sensitizer thickness

params.label: Dry-brush tails
params.note: how far the load runs out before the brush lifts — bristle streaks on the tooth peaks

params.label: Pooling
params.note: sensitizer beading where the brush lands and stops, and the drying rim along each edge

params.label: Exposure
params.note: sun dose; 1 = full development of an unshaded coat

params.label: Object lift
params.note: height of the lifted parts above the sheet — sets the penumbra width and its offset away from the sheet light

params.label: Contact
params.note: share of the subject pressed flat (sharp); the rest curls up (soft)

params.label: Sky scatter
params.note: penumbra per px of lift — skylight and haze around the sun

params.label: Translucency
params.note: UV passing through leaf tissue (cut card: 0)

params.label: Wash bleed
params.note: Prussian blue carried downhill into the whites during the wash, in streaks

params.label: Prints on
params.note: paper = FX-03 live (watercolor-like sheets suit it), cloth = FX-04 live (cyanotype on cotton)

params.label: Tone
params.note: fresh = before oxidation (greener); classic = air-oxidized Prussian blue; peroxide = hydrogen-peroxide bath (deeper, violet-blue); tea = tannin-toned neutral brown

params.label: Blue depth
params.note: film density of a fully exposed coat (Beer–Lambert: deeper and more saturated)

params.label: Custom tone · L
params.note: OKLCH lightness (0 black … 1 white)

params.label: Custom tone · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Custom tone · h
params.note: OKLCH hue angle

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect hangs off this one number

recipe: Coating = brush strokes in stroke space (along s, across t): a load that runs out along the stroke; edges displaced by per-side noise (raggedness); a set-down pool and a drying rim; bristle streaks × the stock height decide where a dry brush still deposits.
Thickness τ = load × unevenness (streaks + low-frequency drag) + pools; overlapping strokes add (a double coat prints deeper); paper valleys hold more sensitizer.
Objects (procedural fern frond, grass with spikelets, or a die) are an AA clip. Lift = a smooth field × the lift dial; contact sets how much lies flat.

Shadow: for each lift level z the clip is sampled toward the sheet light at z · cot(elevation) (smeared ±20 % along the light) and blurred by z × sky scatter; each pixel blends the two levels around its lift.
Exposure E = 1 − shadow × (1 − translucency); density = τ × (1 − e^(−k·exposure·E)) — overexposure fills the penumbra in.
Wash: unexposed coating rinses away; Prussian blue bleeds a little downhill into the whites, in streaks. Color = Beer–Lambert film of the tone (fresh, classic, peroxide-oxidized, tea-toned).
Light last: × the stock's shading under the sheet light.

limits.what: penumbra wider than the leaflets — the fern dissolves into a cloud
penumbra fills in; fine pinnules and awns vanish
pale, greenish print — read as underexposed
